! JO9 MOD START GLORIA_QUEST_STAGE1_20261108
! The first A or better secretary sold to the realtor becomes the successor of Gloria. Saved before the slave is cleared.
		if $npc_id = 'realtor' and rating >= 7 and jo9_gloria_successor = 0:
			jo9_gloria_successor = 1
			jo9_gloria_successor_day = day
			$jo9_gloria_successor_name = $slave_name
			killvar 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave'
			copyarr 'jo9_gloria_successor_slave', 'slave'
		end
! JO9 MOD END GLORIA_QUEST_STAGE1_20261108
		dynamic $clear_slave_instance, 'slave'
